calculation.expression: median_center((-rolling_sum(return,5)/rolling_std(return,20)*sqrt(252))) conditional on lagged equity downside breadth >= 50% and lagged DXY 5-day return > 0
calculation.description: For each tradable asset, rank a five-session volatility-scaled reversal signal only when at least half of the eight equity benchmarks were down on the prior session and the observation-only DXY had positive lagged five-session momentum. DXY is used solely as a macro conditioning signal and is never traded. Values are cross-sectionally median centered implicitly by ranks in portfolio use.

validation.regime_notes: Daily gate is passed, but qualifying IC sample is sparse (25 dates) and all qualifying observations were in 2020-2022; no qualifying observations occurred in 2023-2027. Treat as exploratory and apply conservative portfolio weight until revalidated.
